text: Sorry if this is a silly one. I'm a childminder and have a little girl overnight, she's 4 months old. Just took her temp with the ear thermometer and it says 39.3. Did it twice to be sure. Her neck seems fine, she can tuck her chin and look down at her tummy no problem, so I don't think it's anything like that. Mum and dad are away until tomorrow and I don't want to overreact, but I also don't want to sit on it if I shouldn't. Not sure what I'm meant to do with a baby this little
